dreamteamer.title: Projects
dreamteamer.description: The plan and everyone in it: projects, phases, lanes, activities and gates, decisions, deliverables, risks and teams. A gate is an activity with `kind: gate`, so the plan reads as one ordered list. Owners and seats point at `users`, outside parties at `contacts`. Views band the plan by lane, person and phase, and list gates by holder. `bin/check-records.mjs` enforces what a schema cannot.
